messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert fired -> private-vpc-egress-loss for customer=AcmeCorp, severity=high, svc=private-controlplane, runbook=https://go/runbooks/private-egress, pager: paged alex-oncall at 2864100000 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Triggered escalation policy 'private-vpc-critical' -> escalation level 1, notified: alex-oncall, rachel-oncall
alex-oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Checking their control plane connectivity now. pinging control plane from our private egress probes.
jamie-sre: copying logs from agent fleet for AcmeCorp -> running quick grep for heartbeat failures.
alex-oncall: running traceroute to customer control plane endpoint 10.244.12.7 from edge-az1: `traceroute -n -w 1 10.244.12.7` -> hops stop at 10.10.254.1 (edge egress). Looks like upstream blackhole.
devin-net: I see a BGP withdraw on their peer at 17:07 UTC from their cloud provider (AS64512). Could be an internal route change. Pulling BGP logs.
maya-se: FYI customer reported "all model calls failing" 20m ago. Customer ticket #INC-5421. @sarah-acme can you confirm any changes on your side?
sarah-acme: We had a scheduled network config push at 17:05 UTC to consolidate egress paths but I wasn't expecting interruptions. I'm rolling it back now, will confirm in 2 mins.
alex-oncall: In parallel, I'm enabling fallback: switching AcmeCorp to public-proxy fallback while we assess. Command: `redwoodctl traffic-reroute --customer acmecorp --to public-proxy-1 --reason "egress loss"` -> issued.
ops-bot: Action accepted. Route change queued, estimated propagation ~15s.
jamie-sre: agent fleet logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts to control plane since 17:06:02, and heartbeats drop to 0 for many agents. Sample: ```[2026-03-15T17:06:02Z] agent=acmecorp-agent-3 heartbeat_status=stalled dial_error=connect timeout```
devin-net: Confirmed: their cloud changed egress route and prepended a blackhole community on the peering. If they can't rollback fast, propose we create a temporary NAT via partner-transit to restore control plane reachability.
alex-oncall: Thanks. @maya-se please coordinate with Acme to confirm rollback status. If rollback fails, we need authorization to provision transit.
maya-se: Sarah says rollback didn't fully revert; some subnets still using new path. Can we do transit? Customer ok with temporary NAT if it restores control plane.
alex-oncall: I'm escalating to level 2: paging rachel-oncall for change approval and capacity. `@rachel-oncall` please review.
rachel-oncall: oncall-ack. I approve short-lived partner-NAT. Devin, can you stand up NAT and advertise route for only AcmeCorp controlplane prefix (10.244.12.0/24)? Estimate 8-12 mins.
devin-net: Starting provisioning. Steps: allocate ephemeral transit IPs, update iptables NAT on proxy nodes, inject static route into edge routers for 10.244.12.0/24 -> partner-nat via BGP. I'll post config snippets when done.
alex-oncall: Notifying customer: temporary workaround in progress. maya-se: please update INC-5421 and ping customer success.
maya-se: Updated ticket and sent note to customer: "Working on temporary NAT fix. We'll confirm when control plane heartbeats resume"
ops-bot: partner-nat advertised route accepted by edge routers at 2864100280. BGP next-hop updated.
jamie-sre: I'm re-checking agent logs -> heartbeat count rising. Sample: ```[2026-03-15T17:08:45Z] agent=acmecorp-agent-3 heartbeat_status=ok rtt=42ms```
alex-oncall: Running validation suite against control plane APIs for Acme -> `curl -sS https://private-controlplane.acmecorp.redwood/api/v1/health` -> 200 OK from public-proxy.
sarah-acme: Confirming tools show services back. We see model calls succeeding again. Huge relief.
alex-oncall: Great. Keeping on-call monitoring for 30m. DEV postmortem needed: root cause appears to be customer-side egress policy that accidentally blackholed prefix; mitigated by partner NAT and temporary reroute.
rachel-oncall: I'll start incident handoff notes and schedule postmortem. tagging owners: devin-net, jamie-sre, maya-se.
pagerduty: Alert resolved by user alex-oncall at 2864100440.
alex-oncall: Closing loop: created follow-up JIRA INF-8723 to track permanent fix and automation to detect BGP blackholes earlier. Also asked customer for changelog and guardrails.
maya-se: Customer committed to deploy guardrail for egress changes and to run preflight BGP checks. They've asked for a review call tomorrow.
alex-oncall: Handoff to rachel-oncall at 2864100487 for post-incident monitoring. Thanks team. :team-heart:
